translations.web: Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.
translations.bsb: Whoever sheds the blood of man, by man his blood will be shed; for in His own image God has made mankind.
translations.kjv: Whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.
translations.asv: Whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed: For in the image of God made he man.
